title: A fond farewell to Jeffrey Peters, editor-in-chief of ToxSci
content: In taking the reins of leadership at the journal, my first order of business is to resurrect the fond tradition of publishing impactful editorials that get to the heart of important issues we grapple with on a daily basis as toxicologists. In my next editorial, we will begin to look ahead, but this moment of transition is an excellent opportunity to reflect on the great editorial contributions and service of our outgoing Editor-in-Chief, Dr. Jeffrey Peters.
